# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(UpSetR)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggridges)
library(ggfortify)
library(ggConvexHull)

source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")
source("../scripts/functions/nice_plots.R")
source("../scripts/functions/run_de_analysis.R")

select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
```

## Read data

```{r}
metadata <- read_csv("../data/metadata/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/data_wide.csv")
```

# Dimensionality reduction (PCA)

## Baseline

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Timepoint == "Baseline") |> filter(Disease == "HIV"))$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
Subgroup_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"       = "#65A56E",  # teal / blue-green
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#CD4645",  # mustard yellow
  "More preserved immunity"    = "#E3C35B",  # muted red
  "Elite controller"           = "#377EB8",  # blue-purple
  "Healthy"                    = "#BDBDBD"   # neutral grey
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_baseline_Subgroup <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subgroup)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`),
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  geom_convexhull(
    aes(fill = Subgroup, colour = Subgroup),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = Subgroup_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_hiv()

p_pca_baseline_Subgroup

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_baseline_Subgroup.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/pca/",
  width    = 14,
  height   = 7)

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_baseline_Subgroup.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/pca/",
  width    = 14,
  height   = 7)
```

# Baseline, follow-up and healthy

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Disease %in% c("HIV", "Healthy")))$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Baseline"  = "#E94849",
  "Follow-up" = "#5F98C6",
  "Healthy"   = "#71BF6E"
)

hiv_panels <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite controller"
)

plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  # Make ID into character
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup %in% c(hiv_panels, "Healthy")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Facet_group = Subgroup,
    # ensure Healthy has a consistent Timepoint label
    Timepoint = ifelse(Subgroup == "Healthy", "Healthy", Timepoint)
  )

healthy_df <- plot_df |>
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup == "Healthy") |>
  dplyr::select(-Facet_group) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(Facet_group = hiv_panels)

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup != "Healthy") |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(healthy_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = hiv_panels)


pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_split_timepoint <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # 🔹 Filled ellipses (behind everything)
  stat_ellipse(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(
      fill  = Timepoint,
      group = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom  = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # 🔹 Dashed ellipse outlines
  stat_ellipse(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # 🔹 Thin grey paired lines (HIV only)
  geom_line(
    data = plot_df |>
      dplyr::filter(
        Disease == "HIV",
        Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")
      ),
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # 🔹 Points (on top)
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Timepoint),
    size   = 3,
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = timepoint_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV subgroups compared to Healthy",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Timepoint",
    fill  = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_hiv()

p_pca_split_timepoint

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_split_timepoint_hiv_healthy.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/pca/",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_split_timepoint_hiv_healthy.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/pca/",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 10)
```

#### Baseline & follow-up

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Disease == "HIV"))$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subgroup, shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  # thin grey lines connecting points from the same ID
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

```{r}
pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subgroup, shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
 # geom_convexhull(aes(fill = Subgroup, colour = Subgroup), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", colour= "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`More preserved immunity` = "#64629A", 
                               `Severely impaired immunity` = "#CC5E5E", 
                               `Elite controller` = "#529F96", 
                               `Primary HIV infection` = "#DCAA1F")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values =  c(`More preserved immunity` = "#64629A", 
                                  `Severely impaired immunity` = "#CC5E5E", 
                                  `Elite controller` = "#529F96", 
                                  `Primary HIV infection` = "#DCAA1F")) +
  theme_lordjord93_so()
```

## Treatment

### PCA

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Disease == "HIV"))$DAid)
```

```{r}
pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Treatment, shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  # thin grey lines connecting points from the same ID
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", colour= "black", size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV treatment",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

```{r}
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +

  # 🔹 Filled ellipses per treatment (behind points)
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      fill  = Treatment,
      group = Treatment
    ),
    geom   = "polygon",
    alpha  = 0.2,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # 🔹 Dashed ellipse outlines
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      colour = Treatment,
      group  = Treatment
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # 🔹 Paired lines (same individual)
  geom_line(
    aes(group = ID),
    color = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  # 🔹 Points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Treatment, shape = Timepoint),
    size  = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # 🔹 Reference axes
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +

  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV treatment",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Treatment",
    fill  = "Treatment",
    shape = "Timepoint"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---------------------------
# Define subcategories
# ---------------------------
hiv_panels <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite controller"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare PCA plotting data
# ---------------------------
plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Facet_group = Subgroup
  ) |>
  filter(Subgroup %in% hiv_panels)

# ---------------------------
# Duplicate Elite controllers into all panels
# ---------------------------
elite_df <- plot_df |>
  filter(Subgroup == "Elite controller") |>
  select(-Facet_group) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(Facet_group = hiv_panels)

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  filter(Subgroup != "Elite controller") |>
  bind_rows(elite_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = hiv_panels)

# ---------------------------
# PCA variance
# ---------------------------
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_pca_treatment_facets <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # 🔹 Filled ellipses (per treatment, per panel)
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      fill  = Treatment,
      group = interaction(Treatment, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom   = "polygon",
    alpha  = 0.2,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # 🔹 Dashed ellipse outlines
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      colour = Treatment,
      group  = interaction(Treatment, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # 🔹 Paired baseline → follow-up lines
  geom_line(
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour = "grey80",
    alpha  = 0.5
  ) +

  # 🔹 Points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Treatment, shape = Timepoint),
    size  = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 2) +

  # 🔹 Reference axes
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +

  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV treatment by disease stage (Elite controllers shown in all panels)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Treatment",
    fill  = "Treatment",
    shape = "Timepoint"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

p_pca_treatment_facets

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ---------------------------
# Define treatment panels
# ---------------------------
treatment_panels <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare PCA plotting data
# ---------------------------
plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Facet_group = Treatment
  ) |>
  # keep only treatments of interest + Elite controllers
  filter(
    Treatment %in% treatment_panels |
      Subgroup == "Elite controller"
  )

# ---------------------------
# Duplicate Elite controllers into all treatment panes
# ---------------------------
ec_df <- plot_df |>
  filter(Subgroup == "Elite controller") |>
  select(-Facet_group) |>
  expand_grid(Facet_group = treatment_panels)

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  filter(Subgroup != "Elite controller") |>
  bind_rows(ec_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = treatment_panels)

# ---------------------------
# PCA variance
# ---------------------------
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_pca_treatment_timepoint <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # 🔹 Filled ellipses by Timepoint
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      fill  = Timepoint,
      group = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom   = "polygon",
    alpha  = 0.2,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # 🔹 Dashed ellipse outlines
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype  = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # 🔹 Paired baseline → follow-up lines (within each pane)
  geom_line(
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour = "grey80",
    alpha  = 0.5
  ) +

  # 🔹 Points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Timepoint, shape = Timepoint),
    size  = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 3) +

  # 🔹 Reference axes
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +

  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples by treatment regimen (Elite controllers shown in all panes)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Timepoint",
    fill  = "Timepoint",
    shape = "Timepoint"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

p_pca_treatment_timepoint
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ---------------------------
# Define treatment panels
# ---------------------------
treatment_panels <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare PCA plotting data
# ---------------------------
plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(input_metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Facet_group = Treatment
  ) |>
  # keep treatments of interest + Healthy
  filter(
    Treatment %in% treatment_panels |
      Subgroup == "Healthy"
  )

# ---------------------------
# Duplicate Healthy into all treatment panes
# ---------------------------
healthy_df <- plot_df |>
  filter(Subgroup == "Healthy") |>
  select(-Facet_group) |>
  expand_grid(Facet_group = treatment_panels)

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  filter(Subgroup != "Healthy") |>
  bind_rows(healthy_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = treatment_panels)

# ---------------------------
# PCA variance
# ---------------------------
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_pca_treatment_timepoint <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # ---- Filled ellipses by Timepoint (per facet) ----
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      fill  = Timepoint,
      group = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom   = "polygon",
    alpha  = 0.2,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # ---- Dashed ellipse outlines ----
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype  = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # ---- Paired baseline → follow-up lines (HIV only) ----
  geom_line(
    data = plot_df |>
      filter(
        Subgroup != "Healthy",
        Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")
      ),
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour = "grey80",
    alpha  = 0.5
  ) +

  # ---- Points ----
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Timepoint, shape = Timepoint),
    size  = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 1) +

  # ---- Reference axes ----
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +

  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples by treatment regimen (Healthy shown in all panels)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Timepoint",
    fill  = "Timepoint",
    shape = "Timepoint"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

p_pca_treatment_timepoint + coord_equal()
```


```{r}
pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]
```

```{r}
timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Baseline"        = "#E94849",
  "Follow-up"       = "#5F98C6",
  "Healthy"         = "#71BF6E",
  "Cardiovascular"  = "#FC8D62",
  "Metabolic"       = "#E5C494"
)

hiv_panels <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite controller"
)

reference_groups <- c(
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular",
  "Metabolic"
)

# ---- Base joined table (KEEP EVERYTHING here) ----
base_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(
    metadata |> bind_rows(hdba_metadata),
    by = "DAid"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Timepoint = ifelse(Subgroup %in% reference_groups,
                       Subgroup,
                       Timepoint)
  )

# ---- HIV samples define facets ----
hiv_df <- base_df |>
  filter(Subgroup %in% hiv_panels) |>
  mutate(Facet_group = Subgroup)

# ---- Reference samples duplicated into all HIV facets ----
reference_df <- base_df |>
  filter(Subgroup %in% reference_groups) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(Facet_group = hiv_panels)

# ---- Combine ----
plot_df <- bind_rows(hiv_df, reference_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = hiv_panels)


p_pca_split_timepoint <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # ---- Filled ellipses (behind everything) ----
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      fill  = Timepoint,
      group = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom   = "polygon",
    alpha  = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # ---- Dashed ellipse outlines ----
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # ---- Paired baseline → follow-up lines (HIV only) ----
  geom_line(
    data = plot_df |>
      filter(
        Disease == "HIV",
        Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")
      ),
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour   = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha    = 0.6
  ) +

  # ---- Points ----
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Timepoint),
    size   = 3,
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = timepoint_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV subgroups relative to Healthy, Cardiovascular, and Metabolic disease",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Group",
    fill  = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_hiv()

p_pca_split_timepoint

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_split_timepoint_hiv_healthy_cvd_met.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/pca/",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "pca_split_timepoint_hiv_healthy_cvd_met.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/pca/",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 10)
```

## High vs. low responders

### Baseline

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint == "Baseline") |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  filter(Subgroup != "Elite controller") |>
  mutate(Responder_status = case_when(
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` - `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)` >= 0.6 ~ "High Responder",
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` - `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)` <= 0.2 ~ "Low Responder",
  )) |>
  filter(!is.na(Responder_status))

input_df <- data_wide |> filter(DAid %in% (input_metadata)$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r}
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_baseline_cd4cd8 <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(input_metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Responder_status)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`)) +
  # thin grey lines connecting points from the same ID
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # Add dashed elipses around each Subgroup
  geom_convexhull(aes(fill = Responder_status, color = Responder_status), alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_hiv()
```

### With healthy

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Subgroup != "Elite controller") |>
  mutate(
    delta_cd4cd8 =
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,

    Responder_status = case_when(
      Disease == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
      delta_cd4cd8 >= 0.6  ~ "High Responder",
      delta_cd4cd8 <= 0.2  ~ "Low Responder",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Responder_status))

input_metadata_faceted <- bind_rows(
  # HIV → one facet only
  input_metadata |>
    filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
    mutate(
      Facet = if_else(
        Responder_status == "High Responder",
        "High responders vs Healthy",
        "Low responders vs Healthy"
      )
    ),

  # Healthy → duplicated into both facets
  input_metadata |>
    filter(Disease == "Healthy") |>
    tidyr::expand_grid(
      Facet = c(
        "High responders vs Healthy",
        "Low responders vs Healthy"
      )
    )
)

input_df <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata_faceted$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat        = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample  = TRUE,
  impute     = TRUE,
  seed       = 123
)

```

```{r}
pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_cd4cd8 <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(input_metadata_faceted, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = Responder_status
    )
  ) +

  # 🔹 HIV trajectories (Baseline → Follow-up)
  geom_line(
    data = \(d) d |> filter(Disease == "HIV"),
    aes(group = ID),
    color = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # Points
  geom_point(
    aes(size = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  # Facets
  facet_wrap(~ Facet) +

  # Axes reference
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +

  # 🔹 Dashed ellipse outlines
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
#      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype  = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "High Responder" = "#009E73",
    "Low Responder"  = "#D55E00",
    "Healthy"        = "#0072B2"
  )) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "High Responder" = "#009E73",
    "Low Responder"  = "#D55E00",
    "Healthy"        = "#0072B2"
  )) +

  labs(
    title = "PCA of plasma proteome by CD4/CD8 response",
    subtitle = "Healthy shown in both facets; grey lines connect HIV baseline to follow-up",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Group",
    size  = "CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

)
```
